judgment.reason: B correctly uses the hashable items directly as OrderedDict keys, preserving first-seen order without sorting or mutating the input. A incorrectly applies SHA-1 hashing to the string representation of non-primitive items, which can falsely deduplicate distinct objects that share the same string representation (e.g., custom objects with identical __str__ output). B also includes three complete assert-based tests including the required empty input case, whereas A is truncated mid-test and only shows two tests.
